instruction: Modify the folder name "archive_Q1" and change it to "archive_Q2" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Rename folder with quarter change pattern (archive_Q1 -> archive_Q2). Similar difficulty to original - simple folder rename operation on Desktop. Evaluator checks if renamed folder exists using shell command.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator correctly checks both conditions using compound shell command
Condition 1: '[ -d ~/Desktop/archive_Q2 ]' verifies the new folder exists
Condition 2: '[ ! -d ~/Desktop/archive_Q1 ]' verifies the original folder no longer exists
The && operator ensures both conditions must be true for success message, preventing false positives from copy operations or creating new folder without renaming
Expected value 'Renamed successfully.\n' correctly matches the success output with trailing newline
Semantic correctness: The evaluator accurately verifies the rename operation completed as required by the instruction
